newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Robotics to open client support hub.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Robotics to open client support hub.

text.p: Modem maker U.S. Robotics Corp. said Wednesday it will open a centralized customer support facility in Rolling Meadows, Ill. early next year.

The Skokie, Ill.-based company said it is leasing a site in the Chicago suburb, and plans to spend $10 million to $20 million to upgrade the building. Up to 1,400 jobs will be relocated to the facility over the next three to five years, a spokeswoman said.
"We are trying to centralize like functions, and that's what this plan will do," she said. U.S. Robotics' stock rose $2.625 to $65.625 on Nasdaq at mid-afternoon.
